```{python}
#| label: fig-cost-example
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Required selling price versus sales volume for this exemplary IC: at low volumes, the fixed costs dominate; at high volumes, the price approaches twice the recurring cost."

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

n = np.logspace(6, 8, 200)
price = 2 * (1.58 + 5e6 / n)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 4))
ax.semilogx(n, price, 'b-', lw=2)
ax.set_xlabel('Number of ICs sold')
ax.set_ylabel('Selling price (USD)')
ax.set_ylim(0, 14)
ax.grid(True, which='both', alpha=0.3)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
